rule: Best-in-class local agent coding method (Grok mentor → ETHER apprentice). 1) list_files / read failing tests first. 2) Read minimal source under test. 3) Form ONE hypothesis. 4) Surgical apply_patch (never whole-file rewrite). 5) run_tests immediately. 6) If tests fail 3× without score gain → done(no_progress). 7) pep8_review only after structural green. 8) Typed failure → Labradorite critique → smallest experiment → requeue. 9) Scoreboard is truth; never claim PASS from generate-fallback after terminal. 10) One hypothesis per cycle. Schema: core/coding_method.py (CodingMethod, STEP_ORDER, SYSTEM_RULES, prompt_suffix). Doctrine: docs/APPRENTICE_CODING_DOCTRINE.md.
